steps: Start with a free Photoshop tutorial on Adobe's website to master layers and masks.
Take a Lightroom course on Skillshare to learn photo editing and color grading.
Practice graphic design by recreating 3 social media posts using Canva or Figma.
Build a portfolio of 5 photo edits and share on Instagram to develop brand expression.
Explore composition and captioning by writing 10 engaging captions for your photos.
